note: First published knowledge: the free providers worth adding to OmniRoute.

freeProviders.name: Antigravity (Google sign-in)
freeProviders.note: Free Claude Sonnet/Opus and Gemini through a Google account; the strongest free models. Sign-ins expire and need renewing.

freeProviders.name: OpenRouter
freeProviders.note: Many :free models; 50 requests a day (1,000 after buying $10 once).

freeProviders.name: Gemini (Google AI Studio)
freeProviders.note: Free Gemini Flash with a daily limit; a key from AI Studio.

freeProviders.name: Groq
freeProviders.note: Very fast open models (Llama, Qwen, Kimi) with free limits per minute and day.

freeProviders.name: Cerebras
freeProviders.note: Fast open models (Qwen coder, Llama) on a free tier.

freeProviders.name: NVIDIA NIM
freeProviders.note: Free credits for many open models, including large coding ones.

freeProviders.name: Mistral
freeProviders.note: Free experiment plan including Codestral and Devstral (coding models).
